evidence.says: Script Extender's table of byte patterns names this function: the pattern of its mapping ls::AppliedMaterial::LoadVirtualTexture is found once in the binary and marks this place
The macOS build's symbols hold this name; a stored pair of the two builds joins that function to this one (a seed)
GameEngine.dll exports this name; nothing but the name ties it to this function

questions.ask: What the function does: it is named from Script Extender's table and has not been read
